digest.component_or_area: Jira DC mutation harness and outbound sync
propositions: test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips was red because it attempted to clear fields.parent on a sub-task, which Data Center does not allow

The Epic Link clear path is reachable for standard-issue children via set_parent({epic_link_field_id: None}) because _resolve_local_parent returns (True, None) for detached tickets and fetcher.merge_parent_map overlays DC's Epic Link fallback
The cell must prime the parent through a LOCAL rebar edit to ensure should_propagate_removal recognizes a MANAGED ref, not by Jira-side creation which leaves the ref unmanaged
Clearing the Epic Link on DC 8.17.1 via {epic_link_field_id: None} is confirmed to work by two passing cells in live run 30951453979
The re-homed cell with rebar-primed Epic Link parent passed green in live run 30964805133 with 10 assertions (up from 7), preserving all constraints without weakening any oracle
